arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) check pod honesty: track shaft power vs boat-model power and heart rate; if the pod drifts, set pod_gain. (2) weed/drag: push_local drop within a leg, confirm with ratio, clear rudder if pacer misses. (3) radio/course changes: set_race_distance + tell distance. (4) check critical power with heart-rate trend at steady effort. (5) near finish ensure reserve is spent. Baselines after the start settles (from ~3 min).
